subject: Hosted API renewal and annual scale — proposed tier + rate cadence
messages:
From: Chris Lowe <chris@orbitflow.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@orbitflow.com
Date: Fri, 3 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal — increase commit and burst pocket questions

Hey Mateo,

Hope you had a good week. We're coming up on our hosted API renewal (May 1) and want to discuss expanding our monthly commit and smoothing rate tiers. A quick summary of OrbitFlow's ask:  

- Move from 2.5M tokens / month to 4.0M tokens / month on an annual term.
- Add a 10% monthly burst pocket for seasonal spikes, with predictable overage rates.
- Prefer monthly invoicing but ok to prepay quarterly if that helps with pricing.
- Need confirmation of soft-throttle behavior and latency SLOs during burst events.

I've attached our Q1 usage CSV so you can map the traffic profile. Can you share a couple of renewal options (pricing + any migration windows) and a timeline for legal/procurement? We have to get PO authorization by 3/20.

Thanks — can you loop in pricing/ops if helpful?

Chris Lowe
Head of Platform
OrbitFlow

Attachment: orbitflow-usage-q1.csv (CSV, 42KB)
From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Chris Lowe <chris@orbitflow.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 3 Mar 2028 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal — increase commit and burst pocket questions

Hi Chris — thanks for the data, this is straightforward to scope.  

Two clean options to consider (pricing ballpark included):

1) Annual hosted commit (recommended) — 12 month term
   - Commit: 4.0M tokens / month
   - Burst pocket: 10% monthly (non-cumulative)
   - Rate: $0.0017 / token on commit, $0.0025 / token on overage beyond burst pocket
   - Billing: monthly invoice (net 30) or prepay quarterly for a 4% discount
   - Ops: soft-throttle kicks in at 115% sustained minute rate; auto-fallback to model variant with minimal degradation.

2) Hybrid reserve + hosted (recommended if you expect sustained >30% growth)
   - Commit: 3.5M tokens / month + dedicated burst lane up to 1.0M tokens / month (shared capacity pool)
   - Rate: blended $0.0015 / token for reserved commit, $0.0020 / token for burst usage
   - Billing: upfront monthly reservation charge + usage overage invoice

Next steps I propose:
- Confirm option 1 or 2 (or tell us target commit + preferred billing cadence).
- I'll generate a MAP (mutual action plan) and pricing worksheet for procurement to review.
- Legal/finance: if you want term changes to 24 months we can apply a deeper per-token discount — let me know.

I'm looping in Vanessa (acct lead) and Karthik (pricing/ops) to finalize the MAP and ensure the billing cadence lines up with your PO timing. If 3/20 PO is firm we should have a signed MAP + PO in hand by 3/16 to allow legal time.

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP-OrbitFlow-20280303.docx (MAP draft)
From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 6 Mar 2028 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: OrbitFlow renewal — confirm pricing lane and ops constraints

Team — quick internal note before I send the MAP to Chris. Key points:  

- Original usage profile shows several short high-QPS spikes (5–10 minute windows) — burst pocket should cover these but we need to ensure prefix caching is enabled for their chat flows (ops).
- Margin: option 1 (annual commit) at $0.0017/token yields ~28% gross margin with current infra mix; option 2 (hybrid reserved) gives us higher margin but requires a dedicate-on-demand buffer (ops config).
- Billing: Chris prefers monthly invoices with a PO. If we offer quarterly prepay discount (4%) we can preserve margin and reduce invoice churn.
- Legal ask: procurement may request 60-day invoice terms; recommend pushing back to net30 or accept net45 for annual term only.

Operational checklist for Karthik:
- Confirm soft-throttle threshold and fallback model variant for OrbitFlow's account and add a routing policy to prioritize their primary region (us-west-2).
- Prepare rate-table-v2.xlsx (pricing + prorate examples) and note any SKU changes required for burst pocket.
- Ops to schedule a brief runbook update (15–30 min) so Support can quickly diagnose latency during burst windows.

Vanessa — I'll include a clear MAP timeline and a single DocuSign envelope for signature. If procurement pushes for a 24-month term we can offer a 6% additional discount but need finance approval.

— Mateo

Attachment: rate-table-v2.xlsx (pricing worksheet)
From: Chris Lowe <chris@orbitflow.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@orbitflow.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal — increase commit and burst pocket questions

Mateo — thanks, option 1 looks good to us. Confirming:

- We accept annual 4.0M tokens / month commit with 10% burst pocket.
- Billing: monthly invoice (Net 30). We'll raise a PO and aim to have it to you by 3/20.
- Please send the MAP + DocuSign for signature; procurement expects standard SOW + exhibit with the burst definition.

If you can include the fallback-model clause and a short paragraph on expected latency behavior during burst events that will help speed legal review.

I'll wait for the DocuSign link. Thanks — looking forward to getting this in place.

Chris Lowe
Head of Platform, OrbitFlow
